name: 照明カテゴリーの機器数
prompt:
Create a single compact Japanese lighting-category tile at approximately 164:156 proportions. Reference order: 1) the original low-resolution source crop is the authority for the two-part lighting illustration and the idea of lighting; 2) the localized mock is the authority for the Japanese text and compact vertical hierarchy only.

Preserve the source's paired fixture geometry: a small standing/table lamp silhouette next to a hanging pendant silhouette, as in the original crop. Do not replace them with one generic bulb. Keep both fixtures together as one quiet utility icon near the upper-left, with thin, consistent slate strokes and simple outlines. The original is only 185 px wide, so do not claim exact contour fidelity; retain the recognizable lamp plus pendant relationship.

Use a clean white surface with a subtle neutral border and restrained 16 px corner radius. Do not use the mock's broad pale-mint background. No gradient, colored wash, strong shadow, or large decorative badge. Keep any color accent small and purposeful; the utility icon should remain quiet and readable.

Use exactly two Japanese lines, matching the mock: 「照明」 above 「1台 点灯中」. Keep the label larger and darker than the supporting count/status line, both left-aligned, with the compact spacing and generous inset shown in the mock. Use a Meiryo-like Japanese sans, approximately 14 px for the heading and 12 px for supporting text. Keep the line 「1台 点灯中」 on one line if it fits at this size. Do not add English, other device counts, rows, switches, badges, extra status dots, or surrounding screen UI.

The source says “Lighting” and “1 light”; the mock wording adds “点灯中”. Preserve that target wording without adding any extra claim or visual status signal. Keep the entire rounded tile visible, straight-on, crisp and flat. This is a static component image, not an interactive control.
reviewNotes: Attempt 2 preserves the original lamp-plus-pendant geometry and uses a white utility surface with a quiet border. Target-size comparison shows modest vertical spacing drift. Source only confirms 1 light; mock text 点灯中 remains unverified. Keep needs-correction; source and native file untouched.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
